description: Parliament of Sri Lanka - Order declaring as pensionable posts under Parliamentary Staffs' Act
reasoning: This gazette notification concerns the declaration of certain parliamentary staff posts as pensionable positions under the Parliamentary Staffs Act. It deals with public service administration, specifically the terms and benefits (pension status) of public sector employees, which falls under the Public Service category (Type 8). While it involves the Speaker of Parliament and a Minister, it does not focus on government structural changes, individual personnel appointments, or detailed portfolio responsibilities, but rather on public service administrative matters.
